properties.decision:
SETTLED ON ANTHONY'S WORD, 2026-08-16: HOLD — take option (c), acknowledgement, and build NOTHING yet. `acknowledge_gap` with a reason remains the answer for a design that describes something already running. No new status value, no new project-level field.

⚠️ THIS IS A DEFERRAL WITH A NAMED TRIGGER, NOT A REJECTION. Reopen — as a new Decision superseding this one — when EITHER holds:
  1. a SECOND design turns up that is descriptive end-to-end (one observation in one domain is what is on the table today), or
  2. acknowledgement VOLUME becomes the complaint rather than the vocabulary — i.e. someone reports the count of acknowledgements, not the wrongness of the words.

Recorded so a later session does not read a settled decision as a closed subject.
properties.name: A descriptive design stays on acknowledgement for now — the vocabulary waits for a second instance, and the trigger is named
properties.rationale:
THE CASE IS REAL AND WAS NOT DISPUTED. Modelling the three branches of the US federal government, `Capability.status` is wrong on every rung: `planned` is false for a thing running since 1789, and `realized` means AN ARTIFACT REALIZES IT when there are no artifacts and never will be, because the implementation is not that project's to build. `build_without_verification` and `design_without_build` fire on a design that is complete and correct for its phase.

WHY IT WAS STILL HELD — one reason, and it is the load-bearing one: MOST REAL DESIGNS ARE BOTH. This project's own recorded operating context is brownfield and continual — the ~10-year-old bluesky stack at Brookhaven NSLS-II is partly as-built and partly proposed, and several organisations carry competing partially-built designs. A project-level flag says ONE thing about a design with TWO halves. The honest shape is therefore a project-level default PLUS a per-capability override — which is options (a) and (b) TOGETHER, more schema surface than either alone, on the strength of a SINGLE observation in a SINGLE domain.

⭐ AND THE PROJECT'S OWN METHOD ARGUES FOR WAITING. The decision text's own "not established" line reads: whether descriptive models are a niche worth schema surface, or the first of many. The operating context argues they are not niche — but that is an ARGUMENT, not a MEASUREMENT, and distrusting exactly that gap is this project's standing habit. The increment's repeated lesson is that defects are found by real users and by running two real projects at each other, never by reasoning forward from one report.

WHAT (c) COSTS, stated plainly so the deferral is not mistaken for free: the condition is PERMANENT rather than situational, so this is an unbounded number of acknowledgements for one fact about the project — and the design cannot TELL a reader it is descriptive; only the acknowledgement reasons can, one at a time. That cost is real, it is tedium rather than falsehood, and tedium is a far cheaper problem than wrong schema.

WHAT THE RULING PRESERVES FOR WHOEVER BUILDS IT LATER, because these were the sharp parts and would be expensive to rediscover:
- IT MUST BE ITS OWN FIELD, NOT A `set_project_mode` VALUE. `set_project_mode` today means "how much may a machine change this" and gates exactly one thing — whether `apply_heal` applies or proposes. "What this design IS" is an ORTHOGONAL axis. That field's description was already corrected once in plain language for promising a breadth the code did not implement; overloading it would repeat precisely that over-promise.
- (b) BEATS (a) ON ERGONOMICS where they compete: a project-level statement is said once, where a status value is restated per capability — 38 times for the model in question, with nothing detecting a half-and-half design.
- (d) — folding it into the `adopt` skill — was judged a DIFFERENT case rather than a harder instance: `adopt` recovers a design from something you CAN point a checksum at, and this subject is real but has no artifacts at all.

RAISED BY the US-government genesis session, 2026-08-15 (item 4), which graded it MEDIUM for descriptive models and cosmetic for greenfield software, and which reached the right diagnosis without needing the fix.
